description: This is a database migration script using Alembic for schema changes in the Superset project, specifically updating base columns and constraints.

classes.name: BaseColumnMixin
classes.description: Mixin class providing an 'id' primary key column.

classes.name: DruidColumn
classes.description: Represents the 'columns' table with a datasource_id field.

classes.name: TableColumn
classes.description: Represents the 'table_columns' table with a table_id field.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs schema upgrades: deletes orphaned records, enforces non-null constraints, reduces column size, and adds a unique constraint.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Reverts schema changes: removes constraints, restores column sizes, and nullability.
